_field_guide.display_name: Official card name, from config/cards.json (already fetched via fetch_card_roster.py).
_field_guide.elixir_cost: From config/cards.json -- already reliable, don't need to fill in.
_field_guide.rarity: From config/cards.json -- already reliable, don't need to fill in.
_field_guide.detected_class: unit_detector.py CLASS_NAMES this card shows up as when placed (null for spells, or the documented detection gap: Berserker/Ronin/Spirit Empress/Suspicious Bush/Void/Goblin Giant). A list since a few real cards share one class (Musketeer+Three Musketeers -> 'musketeer'; Skeletons+Skeleton Army -> 'skeleton'; Rascals -> both 'rascal_boy' and 'rascal_girl'; Elixir Golem/Phoenix -> their large/medium/small stage classes).
_field_guide.category: 'troop' | 'building' | 'spell'. Pre-filled from vendor/build-a-bot + spell-by-elimination -- spot-check, don't blindly trust (this project already caught one vendor data error, Ice Wizard's transport).
_field_guide.transport: 'ground' | 'air' | null. Pre-filled from perception/unit_metadata.py (already cross-checked once). N/A for spells/buildings.
_field_guide.target_type: 'ground' | 'air' | 'buildings' | 'all' | null. Pre-filled from vendor/build-a-bot. Spot-check -- not independently verified against real gameplay the way transport was.
_field_guide.movement_speed: NEEDS FILLING IN -- 'slow' | 'medium' | 'fast' | 'very_fast', or a specialty string for cards that don't walk normally (e.g. 'dash', 'dig', 'jump', 'stationary' for buildings/immobile). N/A for spells -- leave null.
_field_guide.hit_speed_seconds: Lower priority, not currently blocking anything. Seconds between attacks, e.g. 1.8. Leave null unless you have it handy.
_field_guide.range_tiles: Lower priority. Attack range in tiles (melee ~1). Leave null unless handy.
_field_guide.sight_range_tiles: Lower priority, not currently needed (see conversation -- this matters for a future targeting-simulation feature, not the tracker fix in progress now). Leave null.
_field_guide.hitpoints: Lower priority, deferred combat stat (per Project_Status -- was already explicitly deferred once for the Phase 4 matchup table). Level-dependent in the real game -- if you fill this in, note which card level it's for.
_field_guide.damage: Same as hitpoints -- lower priority, level-dependent.
_field_guide.notes: Freeform. Pre-filled for a few known quirks (Ice Wizard, Giant Snowball, Musketeer/Skeleton Army class-sharing) -- add your own as needed.
